summary: IME matrix slice implemented and executed with real instruction evidence. (1) a100c/plan/tiles.py: the A100 IME families as data (INT8 8x16x8->INT32 via smt.vmadot none/u/us/su signedness variants, FP16 8x8x8->FP32 via smt.vfwmadot; F030/F031/F051), the operand slot mapping (vs1 = A row-major, vs2 = B column-major), the staging layout (zero-padded M/N/K tails, 512B private workspace), the BF16 vector-FP32 route with the recorded F010/F034 gap, located refusals (int4/sparse/scale/fp8/mixed dtypes/out-dtype narrowing/fp32-ieee), and the pure tile models. (2) a100c/lower/matrix.py: tl.dot lowering to complete program-level MIR -- worker-strided output-tile loop, K loop with the MUL_C=2 m2 accumulator chained as a block parameter (the acc parameter), staging through masked unit-stride loads that perform no access at disabled lanes plus zero merge (vector path when the memory layout provides the tile's contiguous direction, scalar pack otherwise), the tile instruction with a defensive vsetvli x0,zero,e<sew>,m1 prefix (LMUL=1 at every IME instruction even after allocator-inserted reloads), masked strided C row stores with folded M/N guards, and the BF16 ordinary-RVV-FMA path at e32 (exact zext+<<16 widening through an integer staging round trip). New MIR opcodes (vmdot/vmdotu/vmdotus/vmdotsu/vfwmadot + unit-stride vector memory ops) with repertoire rows registered into DEFAULT_REPERTOIRE as data, and IME-aware MIR verification (mir.verify_module for every opcode-agnostic invariant; its UNKNOWN_OP for exactly these opcodes replaced by the IME contract: family formats, LMUL=1 regions, even vd where MUL_C=2, destination/source group overlap, v0 masks, unit-stride regions). The allocator's even-aligned m2 pairs and mixed-LMUL interference edges carry the parity/group constraints unchanged. Executed under the declared QEMU endpoint: int8 24x20x32 compares exact PASS with 18 counted smt.vmadot executions (== the tile model, 9 tiles x 2 k-steps, artifact sha dea6cce65a7a0210...); fp16 20x24x40 (column-major B) compares PASS with 45 counted smt.vfwmadot executions (== model, artifact 43f713e38e59...); the same int8 artifact compares exact PASS at 1/2/4/8 workers with the strided worker split recorded from the runtime's per-worker observation; bf16 compares PASS through the vector path with ZERO smt.* rows (the gap control); the 9x13x17 tail case compares exact PASS with 8 counted tile executions (tails included) and the guard-region witness (staging masks dropped) compares FAIL, proving the zero padding is load-bearing; acc chaining (read_c) and the uint8 smt.vmadotu variant execute and compare PASS. Two located defects in neighbouring backend files were found and worked around without editing them (emit.py vcmpx fills the scalar slot from the vector operand; the allocator's full-vl detection breaks once a constant feeding vsetvli is split) -- both recorded as remaining work for their owners.
